annotations.title: Public records for a Hawaiʻi parcel

description: Answers whether one Hawaiʻi lot has a county tax sale notice (is this TMK on the tax sale list) and what building permits have been pulled for it. County tax sale notices and building permits for one TMK, each with its source. ParcelSheet Pro ($22 a month) only.

address.description: Or a Hawaiʻi street address, e.g. 4-1345 Kuhio Hwy, Kapaa

tmk.description: Hawaiʻi Tax Map Key, 9 digits, dashes optional, e.g. 4-4-2-016-063
